card.text: Young orange star 112 parsecs away in Centaurus, where two giant planets are still forming in a disc.

sources.label: Benisty et al. 2021
sources.quote: PDS70 is a unique system in which two protoplanets, PDS70b and c, have been discovered within the dust-depleted cavity of their disk

introduction.text: PDS 70 is a young K7 star 112 parsecs away. Two giant planets, b and c, orbit inside the gap of its dusty disc, caught while still forming.
